# baseline.baseline_model.baseline_model { #fmrimod.baseline.baseline_model.baseline_model }

```python
baseline_model(
    basis='constant',
    degree=1,
    sframe=None,
    intercept='runwise',
    nuisance_list=None,
    nuisance_check='warn',
    na_action='drop',
)
```

Construct a baseline model for fMRI time series.

Creates a model for low-frequency drift, block-wise intercepts, and
nuisance regressors that account for non-neural signal variations.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type                                      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                             | Default      |
|----------------|-------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| basis          | (\'constant\', \'poly\', \'bs\', \'ns\')  | Type of basis for drift modeling: - 'constant': Constant (intercept only) - 'poly': Polynomial basis - 'bs': B-spline basis - 'ns': Natural spline basis                                                | `'constant'` |
| degree         | int                                       | Number of basis functions per block (ignored for 'constant')                                                                                                                                            | `1`          |
| sframe         | SamplingInfo                              | Sampling frame with block structure information                                                                                                                                                         | `None`       |
| intercept      | (\'runwise\', \'global\', \'none\')       | Type of intercept to include: - 'runwise': Separate intercept per run/block - 'global': Single intercept for all runs - 'none': No intercept                                                            | `'runwise'`  |
| nuisance_list  | list of arrays                            | List of nuisance regressor matrices, one per block                                                                                                                                                      | `None`       |
| nuisance_check | (\'warn\', \'error\', \'drop\', \'none\') | How to handle nuisance columns that are non-finite, zero variance, duplicate, or rank-aliased with the baseline design.                                                                                 | `'warn'`     |
| na_action      | (\'drop\', \'zero\', \'median\')          | Policy for missing values in nuisance regressors. ``'drop'`` preserves the legacy diagnostics-driven behavior; ``'zero'`` and ``'median'`` repair NaN values before diagnostics and design realization. | `'drop'`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type          | Description                |
|--------|---------------|----------------------------|
|        | BaselineModel | Constructed baseline model |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> # Polynomial drift with runwise intercepts
>>> bmodel = baseline_model(
...     basis='poly',
...     degree=3,
...     sframe=sampling_frame
... )
>>>
>>> # B-spline drift with global intercept
>>> bmodel = baseline_model(
...     basis='bs',
...     degree=4,
...     sframe=sampling_frame,
...     intercept='global'
... )
>>>
>>> # Add nuisance regressors
>>> nuisance = [np.random.randn(100, 6), np.random.randn(100, 6)]
>>> bmodel = baseline_model(
...     basis='poly',
...     degree=2,
...     sframe=sampling_frame,
...     nuisance_list=nuisance
... )
```
